notes.title: WebUI hardening from the security audit: deleting a shaper queue, gateway or package needs a POST request; serialized data, redirects and shell arguments are handled safely
New two-row top bar with a notifications panel. Pages are 1200 px wide by default; Wide, Full window width and an icons-only menu are options in System > General Setup
Optional packages: Telegraf starts again, CrowdSec starts after a reboot, ThreatShield keeps local DNS names working and loads its lists in the background with a progress bar
Supersedes 1.1.11, which is not withdrawn. Nothing to do first. Systems on 1.1.1 to 1.1.4 still need the 1.1.5 console command
